title: Joist notching and boring.
officialText:
Notching at the ends of joists shall not exceed one-fourth the joist depth. Holes bored in joists
shall not be within 2 inches (51 mm) of the top and bottom of the joist and their diameter shall not exceed one-third the depth of the
member. Notches in the top or bottom of the joist shall not exceed one-sixth the depth and shall not be located in the middle one-third
of the span.
